english_float_layout.interpretation: Top groups have no preceding text or heading in the column; bottom groups occupy its lower part and have no subsequent text. Captions and table notes belong to their figure/table group. Numeric tolerances are inspection tolerances, not official layout allowances.

intermediate_failures: Initial English export had 9 pages and abstract overflow; resolved by prose and float placement adjustments without shrinking typography.
Intermediate float checks failed; final all-12 inspection passed.
Initial Ruff included temporary editing helpers and failed style rules; helpers removed, final repository check passed.

render_method: Native Microsoft Word ExportAsFixedFormat, followed by PyMuPDF page rendering. Packaged render_docx.py attempted but unavailable LibreOffice executable; no layout accepted without native export and image inspection.
